answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 72 POA per identity, released only after 12 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 220 fakes must lock 15840 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The lotus of the design is public, the violet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ember of honest work is what finally pays.
